result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets with high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. Closed tickets and tickets from other regions are still left out.

I changed the `ORDER BY` in `DataStore.listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`). It now uses the same priority ordering as the sales-rep query, and I updated the method's comment to match. Only the region overview calls this method.

I ran the Region and Ticket test classes and they pass. I didn't add a test for the new ordering, so your T-1 to T-5 example isn't checked directly.
